Supporting systems

The infrastructure behind the pipeline

Strategy needs a steady feed of qualified conversations. Here's how I built the sourcing, scoring, and automation layer that keeps my own pipeline full — and then ran the sales motion on top of it.

Full-Funnel Outbound Build — Language SaaS (Zen Lingo Lab)
LinkedIn + Cold Email outreach system, prepared for Sorrel AI
Apollo.io LinkedIn Sales Nav Segmentation
1
Precision lead sourcing

Boolean and filter-based searches in Apollo to build niche prospect lists by title, industry and company size — no generic lists, only accounts that match the ICP.

2
Data hygiene & segmentation

Verified leads segmented into clean, purpose-built lists before any campaign enrollment — keeping sender reputation and reply quality high.

3
Rules-based automation

Enrollment workflows with strict inclusion/exclusion logic (title, headcount, location, exclusion lists, verified-email-only) routing leads straight into the right sequence.

4
Dual-channel strategy

A tiered LinkedIn outreach layer (connection requests → DM sequence) running in parallel with cold email — coordinated cadence, safety limits, and weekly KPI targets per rep.

AI Lead Scoring & Enrichment Pipeline
Clay + BuiltWith + LinkedIn intent signals
Clay AI Enrichment Intent Signals
1
Signal enrichment at scale

Built Clay tables that pull live job openings, tech stack (via BuiltWith), and hiring trends per company — turning static contact data into a real-time buying-signal feed.

2
AI lead scoring

Layered AI-generated lead scores, target-role classification, and vertical categorization on top of the raw data, so reps work the hottest accounts first.

3
Auto-generated outreach copy

Personalized connection requests, InMails, and multi-step follow-up messaging generated per lead directly from the enrichment data — no manual copywriting per prospect.

Make.com integration scenario
Make.com Pipedrive No-code
1
Zero manual data entry

New rows in Google Sheets trigger an automated scenario that checks for existing organizations, contacts and deals in Pipedrive before creating or updating records — preventing duplicates across a growing pipeline.

2
Branch logic for edge cases

Routers handle connection-request vs. InMail paths and existing-deal vs. new-deal logic, so the CRM stays accurate without a rep touching it.
